reigns.note: Heraclid who won Messenia by the clay lot and wed Merope; Pausanias makes Stenyclarus his royal seat before the rich killed him.
Heraclid usurper who murdered Cresphontes and forced Merope to marry him until Aepytus avenged his father.
Sole surviving son of Cresphontes; restored the Messenian throne and gave his name to the Aepytidae line.
